I design and ship AI-agent systems — Text-to-SQL, coding agents, evaluation harnesses, tool contracts — wired to production data platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, and SQL databases. I also help teams that need AI-agent workflows for migration validation, warehouse optimization, analytics automation, or time series ML.

## What a typical engagement looks like

**Advisory** — A few sessions to scope an AI-agent architecture, review your evaluation strategy, or pressure-test a plan. Good for teams that have the people but need a second opinion from someone who has done it before.

**Embedded principal** — I join your team for weeks or months as an interim lead or senior IC. I own deliverables, coordinate with stakeholders, and ship agentic systems in production. This is how most of my enterprise engagements run.

**Hands-on AI engineering** — I build the thing: agents, guardrails, evals, tool contracts. I write code, not slide decks.

## Good fit

- You are building AI agents against real data — Text-to-SQL, coding agents, RAG over schemas — and need someone who has shipped agentic systems with evaluation discipline.
- You want AI-agent workflows for migration validation, pipeline optimization, or analytics automation on Snowflake/Databricks/SQL databases.
- You are driving AI adoption and need someone to run discovery, align stakeholders, and take agentic PoCs to production.
- You have telemetry, sensor, or time series data and need production ML — not a research paper.
- You need an interim team lead who can own a roadmap, manage stakeholders, and still write code.
